proposal.summary: An improper certificate validation vulnerability (CWE-295) in FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiOS, and FortiSandbox may allow a network-adjacent, unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle communications between the listed products and some external peers.
proposal.affected_product: FortiManager 7.0.1 and below, 6.4.6 and below; FortiAnalyzer 7.0.2 and below, 6.4.7 and below; FortiOS 6.2.x and 6.0.x; FortiSandbox 4.0.x, 3.2.x and 3.1.x

C.quote: may allow a network adjacent and unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle the communication between the listed products and some external peers.

I.quote: may allow a network adjacent and unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle the communication between the listed products and some external peers.

A.quote: may allow a network adjacent and unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle the communication between the listed products and some external peers.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm the vendor advisory, identify patched versions, and apply updates or mitigations to affected systems; if patching is not immediately possible, block or restrict the affected outbound connections to the external peers until validation is enforced.
